svg.title: hybrid-nvidia
svg.desc: NVIDIA hybrids drawn from config.json token-mixer layers. Nemotron-H-56B: 10 attention among 64 mixers (118 layers with FFNs), reported 2.4 times the throughput of Qwen-2.5-72B and Llama-3.1-70B at 64K in / 1K out. Nemotron Nano 2 9B: 4 attention among 31 mixers, up to 6 times Qwen3-8B. Nemotron 3 Nano: 6 attention among 29 mixers, 3.3 times Qwen3-30B-A3B. Jet-Nemotron-2B retrofits Qwen2.5-1.5B: 2 full and 2 SWA layers kept, 24 JetBlocks; KV at 64K falls from 1,792 MB to 154 MB and throughput rises from 241 to 2,885 tokens per second (reported, H100).

text.font-family: STIX Two Math,Cambria Math,Times New Roman,serif

svg.text: KV/tok = Lattn · 2Hkv dh s state = Lssm · H · P · Nstate
Mamba-2 mixers (purple) and attention (blue); FFN/MoE layers omitted · reported throughput
No position embeddings; first layer Mamba-2; attention ≈ 8 % of layers, evenly spread (Nemotron-H).
Jet-Nemotron-2B · PostNAS retrofit of Qwen2.5-1.5B (MLPs frozen, search where attention stays)
all other layers → JetBlock (GDN + dynamic conv on V)
Reported: KV cache size, not parameter count, sets long-context generation throughput (Key Finding 4).
Attention importance is task-specific: retrieval and MMLU depend on different 2–3 layers.
